visualValidation.facing: Right by default; turn begins facing left, passes two native rear-three-quarter bodies and ends facing right.
visualValidation.outfit: Early 2017 Senua: dark braided high ponytail, leather headpiece and silver/blue ornament, blue eye woad and anatomical left-arm woad, fur collar/brooch, brown leather and muted blue plaid, closed boots and left pouch, right-hip iron mirror.
visualValidation.weapons: Initial physical steel sword with ring pommel, right hand; sword sheathed for movement/jumps/Focus/ledge grips. Guard-labelled states depict sword parry. Focus is support mirror handling with no offensive magic or damage.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Original generated gameplay adaptations; no official animation or certified 1:1.
Opposite facing mirrors the sprite including equipment asymmetries; handedness in that camp is not certified.

Official cosplay PDF linked by 2017 Steam announcement was blocked403; no claim of having inspected it. Textual guide mirror and current official Steam imagery are secondary appearance evidence, not source-frame certification.
